dateline: Seoul / Global — Travel day to Stanford; ARIRANG World Tour projected $1.8B; Stanford Stadium debut May 16–19
heroHeadline: Day 4,717: ARIRANG World Tour Projected at $1.8B; Stanford Stadium Debut in 3 Days
heroSubtitle: May 13, 2026 is Day 4,717 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS is in transit to the San Francisco Bay Area for three sold-out shows at Stanford Stadium (May 16, 17, and 19) — making the group only the second musical act in history to perform at the 50,000-capacity venue, after Coldplay. StarNews Korea reports on May 13 that the ARIRANG World Tour is now projected to gross approximately $1.8 billion across its 79 shows in 34 regions — a figure that would rank among the highest-grossing concert tours of all time. On the latest Billboard charts, 'SWIM' rebounds to No. 1 on Billboard Global (Excl. US) and holds at No. 2 on the Global 200, while five BTS albums chart simultaneously on the World Albums chart. A KQED fan logistics guide (published May 12) confirms all three Stanford nights are sold out; gates open at 4:30 PM, shows at 7:00 PM. After Stanford, the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas for four nights (May 23, 24, 27, 28) alongside the 'BTS: The City Arirang' citywide festival (May 20–31 on the Las Vegas Strip).
